items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: I think, Cy Frazier, and, uh, Papa John.

ctx.x: Tell me about, uh, the bands you've heard. You have heard some bands, you know.

Uh, uh, yes, we've heard quite a few. I'd say we've heard about ten, in, not as many days. Uh, well, the most inspired, band we've heard, has been a quartet. Uh, George Lewis, Jim Robinson, Joe Watkins, and, uh, Dolly Adams. It was last, Friday night, I think, at Preservation Hall. Anyway, it certainly reached a, a peak of emotion that left me shattered. The other band that impressed us most was, was Lewis, with, uh, Kid Howard, uh, Albert Warner, and, uh, a rhythm section, who I just forget now, I think, Cy…
Where was this, you heard this last band?
